properties.name: size
properties.description: The size attribute changes the font-size and other related sizes of the component.

properties.name: separator
properties.description: Visual separator rendered between the crumbs.

design.note: In Figma the separator is an instance swap on each Breadcrumb Item (🔄 Separator, Chevron Right or Slash), not a property of the parent. In code a single prop on the breadcrumb governs the whole trail; the chevron default comes from the stylesheet, the template passes the prop through unchanged as data-separator.

properties.name: maxItems
properties.description: Maximum number of crumbs to show before the trail auto-collapses the middle items behind an expand toggle. Values below `2` are treated as `2`.

properties.name: expandText
properties.description: Accessible label for the auto-collapse toggle that expands the trail.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Breadcrumb items for the options API. When set, the trail is rendered from this array instead of slotted `DBBreadcrumbItem` children.

design.name: 📦 Children
design.note: Two slots in Figma (📦 Children and 📦 Children2) that both accept only ↳ Breadcrumb Item and ↳ Breadcrumb Popover Item via preferredValues. In code it is a single default slot.
